indications.description: Adjuvant chemotherapy following chemoradiation for locally advanced stage III or IV nasopharyngeal carcinoma where cisplatin is contraindicated or not tolerated.

treatment.schedule_summary: Adjuvant carboplatin AUC 5 day 1 plus fluorouracil 1000 mg/m²/day days 1–4, normally over 96 hours (22 hours on each day is a source alternative), every 28 days for up to 3 cycles. Begin 4 weeks after prior weekly carboplatin/radiotherapy 00419 following recovery.

administration.notes: 500 mL glucose 5% over 30 minutes; renal-based Calvert dosing.
Normally 96 hours; alternative 22-hour infusion on each of days 1–4. Confirm the prescribed administration plan.

eligibility: Adjuvant treatment after chemoradiation for stage III/IV locally advanced nasopharyngeal carcinoma where cisplatin is contraindicated or not tolerated.
Recovery from preceding weekly carboplatin AUC 2 with radiotherapy; page 1 correctly identifies 00419, while page 2 erroneously prints 00417. Confirm the original treatment record.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to carboplatin, fluorouracil or excipients. A prior mild carboplatin reaction may exceptionally undergo specialist desensitisation under the source conditions; the ordinary regimen cannot authorise this.
